thread:
sasha: Quick design review on Compliance > Storage & Logs. I pulled a few small UX/accessibility/security nits. Posting them here so we can lock copy before the next PR.

andy: Nice, hit me with the list. I can do an a11y sweep once we have mocks.

sasha: 1) Retention control: current free-number input is error-prone. Suggest: replace with segmented control presets (30d, 90d, 1y, Custom) + when Custom selected show a number input with suffix "days". Display human-readable summary like `Retention: 90 days (APIs & Admin logs)`.

rachel: Also add per-log-type breakdown collapsed by default: API requests, Admin actions, System events. Each shows its own TTL and an inline `Export` action.

tom: Region selector: show both name + code e.g. `United States (us-east-1)` and a small placement pill `Data stored in us-east-1`. Tooltip: `Primary storage location for requests & logs. Backups may be stored in a secondary region.` Keep tooltip short.

priya: KMS label is confusing in current mocks. Use `Customer-managed encryption (KMS)` as field heading. Under it: small helper: `Provide the key ARN to encrypt stored logs. We need kms:Encrypt and kms:Decrypt on this key.` Example code snippet: ``arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-1234-ef56``

legal: From compliance: call out that enabling CMK can affect retention exportability and that key rotations may require re-encryption delays. Draft legal blurb: `Enabling a customer-managed key may affect export timelines and retention changes. Contact support for long-running exports.`

andy: Accessibility items: ensure the presets are keyboard-focusable (arrow keys to switch), and the custom number input has `aria-describedby` pointing to helper copy. Warning/error text must be >=4.5:1 contrast versus background when used as body text.

sasha: UX flow idea: put KMS settings in an accordion named `Encryption & key management` with compact summary `CMK: off` or `CMK: ARN: ****-ef56` when enabled. Expanding shows fields and docs links. That reduces visual weight for users not using CMK.

rachel: For the audit log copy, prefer explicit but concise language: `Audit logs (API requests, admin actions) are retained for N days. Exports to CSV/S3 are available; large exports run asynchronously.` Add a microcopy line under the export button: `Exports over 30 days may take up to 24 hours to generate.`

priya: Security note: when CMK is enabled, changing retention to a shorter period should surface a clear warning: `Shortening retention may delete logs that are encrypted with the previous key and is irreversible.` But legal asked we avoid dramatic language. Proposed toned-down warning: `Reducing retention while CMK is enabled may affect exportability of older records. See docs.`

andy: Screen-reader suggestion for region list: announce `Region name, code, compliance notes` e.g., `Europe, eu-west-1, GDPR region`. Use `aria-label` on the region toggle: `Select log storage region`.

tom: Small visual suggestion: show TTL chips next to each log type: `API: 90d`, `Admin: 365d` so users can scan quickly. Also add an inline `Last export` timestamp per log type.

sasha: Copy snippets we can drop into the PR: 
- Retention field label: `Retention`
- Retention helper: `How long request and audit logs are kept for this workspace.`
- KMS heading: `Customer-managed encryption (KMS)`
- KMS helper: `Enter your key ARN. The key must allow kms:Encrypt and kms:Decrypt for Redwood Inference.`
- Export helper: `Large exports are processed asynchronously and you will be notified when complete.`

rachel: I'll mock these in Figma and share a link. Will also include states for empty, enabled, and warning.

legal: Also request a short sentence in UI: `Changes are logged in the workspace audit trail.` helps with transparency.

deploy-bot: Feature flag note: `compliance-storage-v3` enabled for staging-3.

andy: Action items: 1) @rachel produce mocks with keyboard states 2) @sasha write copy PR 3) @priya add security note for docs on key policies 4) @legal sign-off on final phrasing. I'll handle the a11y checklist during PR review.

sasha: Thanks all. If no objections I'll open a small RFC with the exact strings and link to the Figma. :white_check_mark:

priya: +1 from sec. Also: include an API contract note for exports (endpoint, async job id).

legal: +1 pending final text.

rachel: Uploading mock now (`figma.com/file/abcd1234`).

sasha: Great, closing here.
